Consonantal i

Theme

Nature & food

wild adjective

of plants and fruit: growing without care

also wild flowers, wild fruit, wild strawberries, growing wild

classical

Ov. M. 13.815: silvestrī nāta sub umbrā … frāga
Hor. S. 2.2.57: corna; Verg. E. 3.70: arbor (Lewis & Short)

silvestris, silvestre

declension

wild, growing in the woods

Of the woods, wooded; and so of plants and animals that grow wild (Lewis & Short). Columella pairs arborēs silvestrēs ac ferae.

Other words

  • agrestis, agreste — wild, of the fields

    declension · also used · classical · Verg. A. 7.111: agrestia pōma (Lewis & Short); Tac. Germ. 23.1: agrestia pōma; Traupman 407

    Of the country in general, and so of wild fruit and plants; of people it is rustic, and often boorish, uncouth (see rural).

Examples

  • ipsa tuīs manibus silvestrī nāta sub umbrā mollia frāga legēs

    with your own hands you will pick soft strawberries grown in the shade of the woodsOv. M. 13.815–816

  • cibī simplicēs, agrestia pōma, recēns fera aut lac concrētum

    their food is plain: wild fruit, fresh game or curdled milkTac. Germ. 23.1

See also wild, rural.
